title: HookTriggerResponse
description: Response for POST /api/hooks/run (HEL-369). `status` is "succeeded" for a freshly-triggered run that completed without being blocked, "failed" for a freshly-triggered run blocked by an error-severity assertion failure (HEL-570), or the current status of an already in-flight run when the trigger collapsed into it (duplicate-trigger handling, design.md Decision 6).
